parameters.name: AckClusterConnectorId
parameters.description:
The ACK cluster connector ID. You can obtain the value from the following operation:
- [DescribeAckClusterConnectors](~~DescribeAckClusterConnectors~~): Lists ACK cluster connectors.

parameters.name: AckLabels
parameters.description:
The list of ACK cluster pod labels.

> A maximum of 10 labels are supported.

parameters.name: AckNamespaces
parameters.description:
The list of ACK cluster pod namespaces.
> A maximum of 10 namespaces are supported.

parameters.name: AddressList
parameters.description:
The addresses in the address book. Separate multiple addresses with commas (,). Use a space to separate an address from its description within a single address element.

> This parameter is required when GroupType is set to `ip`, `port`, or `domain`.

- When GroupType is set to `ip`, enter IP addresses in the address list. Example: 192.0.XX.XX/32 Development CIDR block,10.0.0.X/24,192.0.XX.XX/24 Test CIDR block.

- When GroupType is set to `port`, enter ports or port ranges in the address list. Example: 80 HTTP port,100/200,3306 Database port.

- When GroupType is set to `domain`, enter domain names in the address list. Example: example.com Test domain name,aliyundoc.com,www.aliyun.com Alibaba Cloud official website.

parameters.name: AssetMemberUids
parameters.description: The list of member accounts for the asset address book.

parameters.name: AssetRegionResourceTypes
parameters.description: The list of regions and resource types for the asset address book.

sub_parameters.name: AssetRegionId
sub_parameters.description: The region ID of the asset.

parameters.name: AutoAddTagEcs
parameters.description: Indicates whether to automatically add the public IP addresses of Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instances that match the specified tags to the address book.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the address book.

parameters.name: GroupName
parameters.description: The name of the address book.

parameters.name: GroupType
parameters.description: The type of the address book.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description: The language type of the address book description.

parameters.name: SourceIp
parameters.description: The source IP address of the request.

sub_parameters.name: TagKey
sub_parameters.description: The key of the ECS tag.

sub_parameters.name: TagValue
sub_parameters.description: The value of the ECS tag.

parameters.name: TagRelation
parameters.description: The logical relationship among multiple ECS tags to match.
